description: Fixed bounded sample-clock IQ observation variation;full source,no RX holdout;exact reused B00 plus three new scratchE20 and full-As reference
authorization: User-authorized Ag+As research with E20 per model and baseline F+CROSS_RX;latest explicit instruction retains every sourceRX/no Ldev. This fixed clock range is an agent research choice from existing receiver-model code,not a claimed measured range or user-specified value.

data.representation: Source ManySig equalized1/IQ256/nativeRMS;formal fixed received residual/post_sync/noeq

permissions.claim_scope: Fixed single-seed full-source clock/As factorial;identity preservation and DG efficacy unproved;no target feedback or automatic seed/budget expansion

checkpoint.initialization: scratch for 3 new models;existing B00/fullAs results reused only

config.training_recipe: Original full-source F+CROSS_RX/RDrop1/LS.01/oldU;four matched L forwards;B00
config.baseline_definition: user explicitly confirmed historical pseudo gate+EMA+cos, not CE-only baseline

feature_extractor.local_projection: learned 1x1 then tanh; shared across controls

config.classifier: unchanged native ResidualPhysicalHead/6x160 cosine/scale30; jointly trained with backbone; no separate training or replacement
config.budget_authorization: 3 new scratchE20/60modelE/13320updates;B00 and fullAs are frozen existing references,not new training or parents
config.baseline_reference: Existing fixed REPEAT is exact B00;existing full CONCAT is additional mandatory reference

training_mechanism.input: Capture actual augmented native L forward input inside L-only context; second forward reuses identical augmented IQ, never pre-augmentation raw batch
training_mechanism.hook_correction: Registered L objective minus native smoothedCE1

sinc_optimizer_units.weight_decay: q -= alpha lambda (q+p0/s); AdamW q decay0
sinc_optimizer_units.native_cosine_schedule: Original alpha cosine; one fixed mapping immediately before each actual step

supcon.descriptor: channel time mean/population std, current L-batch detached standardization floor1e-4, sampleL2 eps1e-4
supcon.negative: otherTX only; sameTX sameRX excluded in CROSS_RX denominator
supcon.two_forward_policy: Mean of first/second losses, each mean of shallow/middle; reuse original actual augmented L IQ and RDrop forwards
supcon.invalid_anchor: Exclude anchors without positive or otherTX negative; finite zero if none; sampler unchanged
supcon.U: Original oldgate/ownEMA/cos untouched; no U TX labels or added U feature loss
